title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Nah-ah, keep those documents away from me... I go all vertigo when I see too much text. Don't even think of making me help you on the paper work, Doctor, I'm just gonna stand here nice and good.

title: Talk 1
original: Armor paint? It's gotta be gold. I love gold. It's the color of lightning, and when they say things are fast as lightning, that's fast!

title: Talk 2
original: For combat, I got my own way of doing things. If you want 'em to respect you, just beat 'em down. If you want 'em to listen to you, go for a round, and let 'em know they could never ever win.

title: Talk 3
original: Armorless Union assassins, Nearl family knights, the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub... how's Rhodes Island hold all of them together? Your recruiting standards are mad out of sight.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I‘ve been honing myself into a campaign knight since childhood. That's how I've learnt all my combat skills. But after I got infected…pssh, I still wanna be a 'knight.' If winning fights is the way to prove myself, then I'll win every fight to show'em all.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Sometimes I don't really get what Sona says, yet I still believe she'll lead us to do right and proper. She's changing and improving herself to adapt, so maybe I'll try working on my own faults too. But, that doesn't mean I'm gonna take up everything she says, haha.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: When Justyna says things, her first sentence is the most important part! But if you don't listen to what comes after, you don't get what the first sentence was about. Good thing I'm already used to that, so I can grasp her point nice and clear.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Justice Knight's my pet. I got people to give her a bunch of functions, so she's got the chops to do it all at least a little. Yeah, she's a real doer!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I made the title 'Wild Mane' renowned through my own hard work. It's the symbol of a Knight as strong as hell, and an Infected Knight even. However, the General Chamber of Commerce takes our lives and our glory no more than products and consumables. Tch. Sucks I can't pound their masks to pieces right damned now.

title: Idle
original: Man, I'm so bored... hey, let's go for a drink. It's always Ashley who drinks with me, and that's just dull.

title: Onboard
original: Wild Mane' Iwona, I'm a Knight from Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub. Sona says this place does good by the Infected? Sounds cool.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Ooh... that's a sick surprise attack to make! Can we rewind that and watch it again?

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? Then you can tell I've gotten stronger? Haha, fine by me, gimme a few more!

title: Promotion 2
original: Those hypocrites, wearing hollow masks and treading on the Infected as they want. Screw them, my lance is gonna run them all through!

title: Added to Squad
original: Who's got the guts to spar with me?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Phalanx formation suits me most. If I'm the captain, then let's go with my kind of tactics!

title: Depart
original: Let's roooooll!

title: Begin Operation
original: Haha, I got you sighted.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Leave the brawling to me.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I've been waiting forever!

title: Deployment 1
original: You guys think you're worth my full strength?

title: Deployment 2
original: Don't you dare go down in one!

title: In Battle 1
original: Slow! Slow! Way too slow!

title: In Battle 2
original: Haha, you're not dodging this!

title: In Battle 3
original: Lance charge!

title: In Battle 4
original: Piercing through!

title: 4-star Result
original: Keep on winning, and you'll never be forgotten. It's that simple.

title: 3-star Result
original: Cheers, Doctor. You're a solid commander.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: My Major Lance... *sigh* Gotta get repairs again.

title: Operation Failure
original: Leave any regrets for later! Go, I'll cover the rear!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Any rooms in all gold around here? Just a little dream of mine.

title: Tap
original: What, you wanna have a race with me?

title: Trust Tap
original: Skirts? Nuh-uh. I don't wear 'em 'cept for special days.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Haha, just bought some confetti cannons from the stand over there. Sparking Golden ones, of course, to suit the day best! The instructions here... Gah, never mind, I'm not reading through this wordy crap. Here, Doctor, hold this one in your hand and I'll count to three. Three! Two! One— What the...? Where's the BOOM?  Production date, you say? ... EIGHT YEARS AGO?! Where's that stand owner? He'd better be gone for REAL!

title: Greeting
original: Ready for the day, Doctor? Wanna try some breakfast from the Justice Knight?

title: Birthday
original: Here, your birthday present, you're gonna love it for sure! Last time when Sona and the rest unpacked my gifts, I could tell they were trying hard to keep a calm face just because they could barely contain their excitement inside! C'mon now, this time I wanna see YOUR reaction— Surprise! Did you guess it? A pair of lightning-patterned socks! Cool, isn't it?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I only agreed to move with the others to Rhodes Island at first because it was Sona's idea. I may not have her perception and capability, but one day people will come to realize I'm doing more than just proving my strength, that I'm giving my all so that people can look at us infected with unbiased eyes.
